title: Sessions claim the task they start, and a closed session's claim clears itself

requirements.text: genlock start takes a claim on the ticket; a second live session's start is refused, naming the holder
A claim records its agent's claude pid and start time; when that process is gone the claim is released on the next read, and while alive it does not lapse
A SessionEnd hook releases every claim of the ending session, and genlock install writes it
orient, continue and rank mark tasks held by another live session (session + pid), and claims shows alive/gone
requirements.check: manual: run orient/claims in this repo and read the marks

requirements.text: Taking over a task a live session holds needs --take-over with --user-said

evidence: tests/run.mjs: 'start claims the ticket for this session' and 'a second live session's start is refused, naming the holder' pass; 511 passed 0 failed

tests/run.mjs: claim records sleep pid+start; holds past expired lease ('pid N running'); after SIGKILL gone from claims, file cleared, other session starts it. Live: claims shows 'agent pid 60579 running' (this claude)
tests/run.mjs 'session-end releases every claim of the ending session' passes; .claude/settings.json now has SessionEnd -> genlock session-end; install.mjs puts SessionEnd under coordination

node bin/genlock.mjs rank tasks / orient here: T-CRBJM 'this session is on it', 6 in-progress tickets 'no live session holds it: free to pick up'; tests: rank/orient show 'TAKEN by session parent' to another session
tests/run.mjs: --take-over without --user-said exits 4; with it exits 0 and show prints 'taken over from session parent'

answers.observed: 511/511 tests incl. 19 new; live claims names pid 60579 = this claude (ps tree node->zsh->claude)
answers.cause: liveness = kill(pid,0) + ps lstart match, measured in tests with a real killed process
answers.absence: the app's bundled genlock (on PATH) still runs old code, so running sessions do not claim on start until the app is rebuilt
answers.assumption: claude process is an ancestor named claude in argv[0..1]; a node-wrapped install with another name falls back to the 60-min lease
answers.falsify: a session closed in the app whose claim still appears in genlock claims afterwards

text: Built: start claims ticket (refuses live other holder; --take-over --user-said), claims carry claude pid+lstart and drop when it dies, SessionEnd hook releases, rank/orient/continue mark TAKEN/free. 511 tests pass. Not committed. App bundle's genlock is old until rebuild.
